scenicChapters.title: Romantic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 18 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Romantische Strasse
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 24 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Abrigo de la Llagosa → Molino de Capel I
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-abrigo-de-la-llagosa-cueva-del-pe.story: 309 km from Nerpio to Nerpio, about 5 h 20 of riding. On the way it passes Molino de Capel I, Abrigo del Pozo III, Abrigo de los Cortijos and Cueva del Peliciego. The highest point is about 1,400 m. The line favours views over speed.
